summary: 10.0.38.09 Post-Login Screen Unmasking and Synchronous Auth Dismissal Engine
highlights: 1. Synchronous Auth Overlay Dismissal: Removed async/network blocking from login completion, immediately unmasking #app-container and hiding #auth-overlay upon credential validation.

2. Deterministic CSS Visibility State: Enforced html:not(.auth-required) rules in app.css and index.html ensuring display: none !important for auth-overlay and visibility: visible !important for app-container.
3. Zero-Delay Role Fallback: Ensured login-role selector automatically falls back to ADMIN if left unselected, preventing role-binding deadlocks.
4. MutationObserver Mutation Filtering: Optimized DatePickerFormatter observer to only fire when date inputs are actually added to DOM, preventing unnecessary reflows.
5. Full Workspace Integration: Retains all 10.0.38.06 light mode enhancements, responsive KPI ribbon styling, 345px Master Data categories, and GSTR-1 navigation.
